sentence: This project builds artificial intelligence tools that let scientists see organelles in microscope images without having to label them.
This project builds statistical models that use ecological data to estimate hidden processes such as animal movement and species interactions.
This project tries to find out whether engineered proteins can bind soil particles and calcium carbonate minerals to make soil stronger.
This project holds a workshop on applying quantum computing and trustworthy artificial intelligence to engineering problems.
This project develops statistical theory and methods for sparse mixture-of-experts.
This project studies how a catalyst and gas reactions work together to turn methane into ethane and ethylene.
This project tries to find out how the fungus that causes blast in rice builds a septin ring to invade plants.
This project builds a computer program for designing DNA origami nanostructures.
This project adapts experiential computing labs on artificial intelligence and cybersecurity for high school classrooms.
This project builds gene editing tools to make tropical maize flower earlier so it can be used in breeding programs.
This project builds a network of educators who share teaching modules on microbiome science across many institutions.
This project studies how aging and diabetes change the extracellular matrix and how that affects the spread of breast cancer cells.
This project tests how sampling environmental DNA in an estuarine fishpond can help faculty teach data science with community partners.
